helpline.heading: HELPLINE 112
helpline.subheading: Call us for any emergency support response immediately
helpline.paragraph1: Dial 112 is a nationwide emergency helpline implemented by Government of India designed to provide swift and efficient responses during emergencies. In Telangana this services is available 24*7 ensuring that citizens can easily connect with emergency services like police, fire, and medical assistance all through a single number 112.
helpline.paragraph2: The Telangana Government in collaboration with various services, aims to offer timely help in critical situations, reducing responses times, saving lives and improving the overall safety of its citizen.

questions.question: What is ERSS (Dial 112)?
questions.answer: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) is a pan-India single number (112) based emergency response system for citizens in emergencies. Each State/UT is required to designate a dedicated Emergency Response Centres (ERC) to handle emergency requests. ERSS connects citizens to the appropriate emergency services like Police, Fire, Health, and other disaster management services.

questions.question: When should I call 112?
questions.answer:
You should call 112 in any emergency situation where immediate assistance is required from Police, Fire, or Ambulance services. Examples include:
  • Medical emergencies
  • Fire outbreaks
  • Crimes in progress
  • Road accidents
  • Women safety issues
  • Natural disasters

questions.question: Is 112 available 24/7?
questions.answer: Yes, the 112 service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year.

questions.question: Can I call 112 from a mobile phone without a SIM card?
questions.answer: Yes, in most cases, you can dial 112 from a mobile phone even without a SIM card or if the keypad is locked, provided there is network coverage from any service provider.

questions.question: What information should I provide when I call 112?
questions.answer:
When you call 112, try to stay calm and provide the following information clearly:
  • Your location: Give the exact address or landmarks.
  • Nature of emergency: Explain what has happened.
  • Details: Provide details about the number of people involved, injuries, etc.
  • Your contact number: So that the emergency team can call you back if needed.

questions.question: Is there an app for 112?
questions.answer: Yes, the '112 India' mobile app is available for both Android and iOS devices. It provides a panic button and allows you to send your location and details to the ERC instantly.

questions.question: What happens if I call 112 by mistake?
questions.answer: If you call 112 by mistake, please do not hang up immediately. Stay on the line and tell the operator that everything is fine. Otherwise, the operator may assume there is an emergency and dispatch help.

questions.question: Does 112 replace other emergency numbers like 100, 101, and 108?
questions.answer: 112 is designed to be a consolidated single number. However, the existing emergency numbers (100 for Police, 101 for Fire, 108 for Ambulance) continue to be in operation and are integrated into the 112 system.
